## Why

A dossier print is the artifact a resident hands to a council member —
but it printed as a flat stream: no first-page brief, no page numbers,
no figures, no way back to the live page. K14 UXK14-9 names the fix:
a council-brief page 1, running head/foot on every page, the terms
list, a QR back to the pinned permalink, every figure carried, and the
print rules that make paper honest (no split figures, no orphan pages,
greyscale-safe marks).

## What lands

- **`web/src/lib/print.ts`** — the composition layer:
  `sig.print-figure/1` declarations (kinds `map`/`extent`/`trend`/`axis`,
  each an artifact pointer + state + note — a kind the static figure
  kit cannot yet draw (P36.27/28) prints as the labelled hatch
  placeholder, a **named absence, never a fabricated visual**), the
  `planPrintPages` document model (`brief` → one page per declared
  figure → `sections` chunks → `terms`), `recordedGlance` (the
  at-a-glance counts off the shared field audit), `councilDecision`
  (the derived next-decision date or its typed absence), and
  `documentsToBring` (the record's own locators — nothing written by
  hand).
- **`web/src/lib/qr.ts`** — a dependency-free byte-mode QR encoder:
  EC level M, versions 1–10, Reed–Solomon + block interleaving,
  mask + format information, emitting SVG path data with a quiet zone
  at build time. Verified against `segno`/`reedsolo` reference output
  and decoded by OpenCV; capacity overflow is refused loudly.
- **`web/src/lib/dossier.ts`** — `dossierFieldAudit` extracted as the
  shared unknown-field audit (`dossierUnknowns` keeps its shape); the
  dossier contract gains the optional `print_figures` list.
- **Print components** (`web/src/components/print/`):
  `CouncilBrief.astro` — page 1: kicker, title, jurisdiction,
  recorded/unknown at a glance, the incompleteness banner, the "What
  we don't know" summary, next decision + documents to bring, and the
  QR of the pinned permalink; `PrintChrome.astro` — the running head
  (place + document kind) and footer (as-of pair, release-if-bound,
  permalink, licence-if-bound, `Page n/N`, the P35.42 cite sentence)
  composed on every logical page; `PrintFigure.astro` — one declared
  figure per page, never split; `PrintTerms.astro` — the print-friendly
  terms-used list (non-interactive, lexicon-backed links).
- **`web/src/pages/dossier/[...path]/print.astro`** — restructured to
  the explicit page plan; the JD copy rows keep their in-page bindings
  (the combines/unmapped sentences and the release stamp render through
  named slots so the copy-batch binder still sees them in the route
  file).
- **`web/src/lib/dossier-figures.ts`** — print-only `glance-recorded` /
  `glance-unknown` specs: the brief's at-a-glance counts render inside
  figure regions like every other material number (SIG-TRANSP-013) —
  the figure gate reports **zero** bare numerals on every print page.
- **`web/src/styles/print.css`** — the `.sig-print-*` set plus `@page`,
  moved out of `epistemic.css`; `break-inside: avoid` on figures,
  `break-after: avoid` on headings (no orphan headings/rows), and
  greyscale-safe marks — borders, hatches and labels carry state,
  never colour alone.

## Tests

- `tests/unit/qr.test.ts` (10): matrix shape/version bounds, finder /
  timing / dark-module / format placement, byte-mode codewords,
  Reed–Solomon + interleaving against `reedsolo`, SVG path + viewBox,
  capacity rejection past version-10-M.
- `tests/unit/print.test.ts` (14): page planning order and counts,
  the council-brief model (glance, decision or typed absence,
  documents), terms aggregation incl. release/pinned-citation terms
  only when bound, `sig.print-figure/1` kind validation, named
  absences.
- `tests/e2e/print.spec.ts` (new): page-1 brief, running chrome on
  every page (`Page n/N`, as-of, permalink, licence-if-bound), page-kind
  order, QR SVG attached, the terms strip on the last page, expanded
  reconciliations for a paper reader, PDF emission ≥ one sheet per
  composed page, zero `<script>` (T0).
- `tests/e2e/print.nojs.spec.ts` (new): the complete document with
  JavaScript disabled.
